figures.finding: Bermuda's films are funded by the Bermuda Arts Council's grants, given through the Ministry of Youth, Culture and Sport and its Department of Culture: in 2021 two film projects, a short and an hour-long documentary, received $5,000 each, for production, post-production, cast and crew.

value.fund: Bermuda Arts Council grants (Department of Culture, Ministry of Youth, Culture and Sport)

figures.applies: Bermuda, as the Government's press release of 17 March 2021 reports; the Bermuda Tourism Authority's film commission page (read 2026-11-02) names work permits, customs and local-agent rules but no production incentive.

sources.said: Today the Minister of Youth, Culture and Sport, Dr. the Hon. Ernest Peets, JP, highlighted two recent recipients of the Bermuda Art Council (BAC) Grants. Mr. Rory Wilson and Mr. Rick Richardson each received $5,000 to assist with their respective film projects. … Rick Richardson is currently producing an hour long documentary called Victory … the value of the Department of Culture’s and the Bermuda Arts Council’s investment in our local art makers. … The funds will be used to cover the production costs of filming and post-production; paying cast and crew

Bermuda law requires non-Bermudian production companies to engage a local Bermudian agent or production company . … Persons working on a film, video or photography production project must obtain a work permit.
